mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.board, p.symbol, p.title, u.nickname AS author_name, p.status, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.created_at FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET status = #{status}, deleted_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'DELETED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE deleted_at END WHERE id = #{postId}
mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, p.title AS post_title, u.nickname AS author_name, c.content, c.status, c.created_at FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON p.id = c.post_id JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id

SELECT r.id, r.target_type, r.target_id, CASE r.target_type WHEN 'POST' THEN (SELECT p.title FROM posts p WHERE p.id = r.target_id) WHEN 'COMMENT' THEN (SELECT c.content FROM comments c WHERE c.id = r.target_id) END AS target_summary, r.reason, r.detail, r.status, u.nickname AS reporter_name, r.created_at FROM reports r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.reporter_id
mapper.update: UPDATE reports SET status = #{status}, handled_by = #{adminId}, handled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{reportId} AND status = 'PENDING'
